interactions.name: soft_load
interactions.action: At neutral wheel angle settle, apply contact probe over patch, unload and recover; measure relative to rotor.
interactions.expected: Real MuJoCo flex and native skin exhibit local nonrigid displacement and recovery; failed response retained as failed evidence.

review_requirements: Record nonempty source-face ownership for every planned moving visible part and the active tread skin; each source face has exactly one owner. Verify rest-position, UV and PBR preservation. Inspect fork arms/fenders/stays separately from spinning rotors, lever separately from grip, latch separately from stem, and the entire thin stand through its attachment. Report added area for each of the four authorized supports and total <=0.051; no native face removal/editing.

For steer, fold, stand_pivot, brake_press and latch_release inspect actual bound native surfaces at minimum, midpoint and maximum of the declared interval, recording visible connection gaps and wrong-owner movement. Steering carries fork, wheel and bars; folding moves upper stem/controls while fork and wheel stay on the lower carrier. Release latch before folding with steering neutral. Stand moves toward a plausible stowed pose and lever approaches the grip. Record actual fitted pivots and rest frames; use supported preview offset mapping. Only the four reviewed bounded connectors are authorized. Report cable discontinuity separately from rigid attachment failure; no hidden interior reconstruction or dense sweep required.

Compile front_spin and rear_spin as hinges with limited=false and no range or actuator accumulated-angle bounds. In the single host attempt command each through at least 2*pi accumulated unwrapped rotation and report actual travel. Inspect bound native surfaces at representative 0, pi and 2*pi poses: fenders/stays remain on correct support owners and the front soft patch/pins follow its rotor. A symmetric full-turn endpoint alone is insufficient visible-motion evidence. Never convert these joints into limited oscillation.

Build nondegenerate coarse flex tetrahedra with free deforming nodes and rotor-attached boundary nodes. Bind every front_tread_patch native vertex with valid covering weights and report rest reconstruction error without duplicate rigid skin. In the one host attempt, at neutral wheel angle apply and remove the declared contact probe, record contact and native-skin displacement relative to front_rotor, normalize using the host's declared displacement criterion, and report recovery after unloading. Rigid wheel motion or an invisible flex cannot count as deformation. Report failed thresholds honestly while retaining the bound candidate.

Use only the one host dynamics attempt; report finite-state stability, actual angular endpoint errors against frozen tolerances, and contact helper classifications including neutral contacts. Baseline depth <=1 percent object diagonal needs no locality proof; extensions require the helper's real locality evidence. No broad/deep overlap exemption and no continuous-joint range reduction. Save complete GLB/MJCF/action plan/manifest early, then retain usable interactions even on failure. Delivery distinguishes planned actions, measured simulated successes, parameter preview controls, failures and missing actions, with all deferred compliance owners and geometry/collision gaps explicit.
